claims.subject: sorin_markov

evidence.quote: Nahiri turned and was faced with her old mentor. Her sworn enemy.

claims.summary: Sorin is Nahiri's old mentor and sworn enemy; he confronts her on Zendikar.
claims.limitation: The quoted sentences precede the line naming him ("Sorin."), which is shorter than the quote minimum.

claims.subject: nissa_revane

evidence.quote: And easily, so easily, Nissa's magic merged with the Core's power.

claims.summary: Nissa channels the Lithoform Core's power with her own magic.

claims.subject: nahiri

evidence.quote: She should have found a different plane to trap the Eldrazi in millennia ago.

claims.summary: Nahiri helped trap the Eldrazi on Zendikar millennia ago.
claims.limitation: Point-of-view narration; the pronoun's referent is the viewpoint character named in the summary, not named in the quoted sentence.

claims.subject: ulamog

evidence.quote: Zendikar's Vampires were created many centuries ago by a magical infection that originated from the Eldrazi and enslaved them to Ulamog's will.

claims.summary: Zendikar's vampires were created by an Eldrazi-born infection that enslaved them to Ulamog's will.

claims.subject: kesenya

evidence.quote: a veteran explorer who led the ﬁrst expedition into the Tazeem Skyclave—known as the Sky Ruin of Emeria

claims.summary: Kesenya led the first expedition into the Tazeem Skyclave (the Sky Ruin of Emeria).

claims.subject: kesenya

evidence.quote: they formed the nucleus of the new Sea Gate Expeditionary House
It was founded by a kor woman named Kesenya

claims.summary: Kesenya, a kor explorer, founded the new Sea Gate Expeditionary House.
claims.limitation: The quoted 'It' refers back to the new Sea Gate Expeditionary House in the surrounding paragraph.

claims.subject: kargan_tribes

evidence.quote: the Kargan tribes mastered the dragons of Akoum and rode them to victory against the kor, shattering the Akoum Skyclave

claims.summary: The Kargan tribes rode Akoum's dragons against the kor empire and shattered the Akoum Skyclave.

claims.subject: ondu_skyclave

evidence.quote: Then civil war tore the empire in half; the Ondu Skyclave turned against the capital at Makindi.

claims.summary: In the kor empire's civil war, the Ondu Skyclave turned against the capital at Makindi.

claims.subject: makindi

evidence.quote: The great capital city of Makindi, which gave its name to this kor empire, was in Ondu

claims.summary: Makindi, capital of the ancient kor empire named after it, was in Ondu (now the Makindi Trenches).

claims.subject: lorthos

evidence.quote: An enormous sea monster—perhaps an ancestor of Lorthos, the Tidemaker, or maybe Lorthos itself—dragged the Murasa Skyclave into the sea.

claims.summary: A sea monster, possibly Lorthos or an ancestor of it, dragged the Murasa Skyclave into the sea.
claims.limitation: The page itself leaves open whether it was Lorthos or an ancestor.

claims.subject: ayya

evidence.quote: open only to trained brakeguards like Ayya, Obuun's mother

claims.summary: Ayya, a trained brakeguard, is Obuun's mother.

evidence.quote: The armor that Uncle Dykaar had bought for Obuun hung from a vine

claims.subject: obuun

evidence.quote: Uncle Dykaar's lessons may not have helped Obuun fit into Riverroot Village
he could at last sense the spirits of Riverroot Clan

claims.summary: Obuun is an elf of Riverroot Village and the Riverroot Clan.
claims.limitation: Membership is implied by his home village and ancestral spirits, not stated as a title.

claims.subject: orah

evidence.quote: Orah certainly cursed Zareth for his flight and threatened to kill the boy if he returned

claims.summary: Orah threatened to kill Zareth if he returned, which Akiri reads as hidden love and fear.

claims.subject: akiri

evidence.quote: She noticed the labored breathing of Akiri, Zareth, Orah, and Kaza behind her

claims.summary: Akiri, Zareth, Orah and Kaza climb with Nahiri's party.
claims.limitation: Point-of-view narration; the pronoun's referent is the viewpoint character named in the summary, not named in the quoted sentence.

claims.subject: nahiri

evidence.quote: Akiri hadn't managed to save or protect anything she loved in those desperate minutes before Nahiri pushed her.

claims.summary: Nahiri pushed Akiri off the floating ruin.
